resources.string: Sign in to a server to configure smart downloads.
Keep the next unwatched episodes for your selected series. Specials are excluded. Downloads use app storage and appear here when complete.
Cleanup happens after watching and server synchronization. Only this feature’s local files are removed. Manual downloads and server media are untouched.
Use trusted HTTPS, or a private HTTP address and port with explicit trust below. Leave blank to use only the configured server. Direct LAN downloads require unmetered Wi-Fi.
Allow downloads through the configured remote endpoint

Uses the signed-in server address if LAN is unavailable. Its configured transport and VPN route are retained. If disabled, downloads wait for verified LAN access. Wi-Fi and storage limits still apply.
Series choices save immediately. Deselecting stops new downloads and keeps existing files. Watched managed files still follow your automatic cleanup setting.
No series selected. Browse or search below, then choose a show.
No matching series. Try another title.
After selecting shows, save your settings below. Completed episodes appear in Downloads. Watched episodes are replenished after progress syncs; automatic checks run approximately hourly.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 100 GiB.
Use a valid HTTPS URL, or HTTP with a private numeric IPv4 address and explicit port. Credentials, queries and fragments are not allowed.
Choose a home LAN endpoint or allow downloads through the configured remote endpoint.
HTTP requires explicit trust for this exact address. Review the option below.
HTTP exposes your Jellyfin session token and media on this Wi-Fi network. A matching server ID does not protect against impersonation. Changing the address requires trust again.

%1$s

Your Jellyfin session token and media will travel unencrypted over direct Wi-Fi. Someone on this network could intercept or alter them. Server-ID matching is a consistency check, not secure authentication.

Trust applies only to this address for this account, after you save. HTTPS is never automatically downgraded. Watch-state synchronization and cleanup confirmation keep using your normal server connection.
Your setting changes have not been saved. Series selections are already saved separately.
Fix the field errors above to save.
Settings save when you press the button below.
Settings saved. Check queued; it has not necessarily started.
Settings saved. Automatic downloads are off.
No check is scheduled. Save to queue a check.
Android starts checks when network, storage and background limits allow. Queued does not mean running.
Showing up to 50 shows. Search by title to find more.
Tap to keep next episodes offline
%1$s deselected. Existing downloads are kept; watched files still follow automatic cleanup.
Local transfers and watch synchronization are shown separately. Eligible files are removed during a permitted check, after the server confirms watching.
Show deselected · no new episodes will be added.
Watch progress waiting for server sync
